text: Expose backlog relationship traversal via query_graph when stub is implemented. Currently BacklogEdge nodes (parent_of, depends_on) are stored in CozoDB but query_graph is a pre-existing stub returning GraphQueryError::Invalid. When query_graph is implemented, backlog edges should be traversable. Source: docs/closure/2026-05-05-002-F-backlog-hydration-closure.md

Add 'backlog' source type to default registry scaffold generated by 'engram install'. Currently the install command creates a registry.yaml without a backlog source entry — users must add it manually. The install command should detect if a .backlogit/ directory exists and offer to add a backlog source. Source: docs/closure/2026-05-05-002-F-backlog-hydration-closure.md

Implement query-graph: replace stub with real graph query execution — query-graph CLI subcommand and MCP tool currently return GraphQueryError::Invalid (stub). Real graph query DSL and execution is future scope. Labels: graph,query,follow-up. Source: docs/closure/2026-05-07-042-F-cli-parity-closure.md
